INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

2. When practising Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Comprehension.

3. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.

4. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.

   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.

   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.

7. When practising Attentive Listening: Poetry, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening: Poetry.

8. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Expressing Self Creatively and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information: News and Adverts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 5.3.1: Functional Writing: Shopping List and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
